title: Multichannel Issuance Payments
summary: Customers need choices, whether they’re in-store, in-branch, or online. Learn to select the best solutions for your issuance approach.
body_markdown: According to a recent online survey conducted by CPI® of more than 2,000 consumers, respondents stated they favor using a digital wallet when waiting for a physical card. This means they appreciate being able to choose between physical debit or credit cards, digital wallets, and other payment methods.
